title: Kubernetes ResourceQuota：請求額度、執行用量與可排程性的差別
titleEn: Kubernetes ResourceQuota: admission budgets versus usage and schedulability
subcategoryTitle: 多租戶、復原相依與可用性邊界
subcategoryTitleEn: Multitenancy, recovery dependencies and availability boundaries
summary: 從合成Pod清單累計CPU requests，計算新Pod是否超額；另記limits及觀測用量，禁止以低使用率繞過額度判斷。
summaryEn: Sum CPU requests from a synthetic Pod inventory and decide whether a new Pod exceeds quota. Record limits and observed utilization separately; low current usage must not bypass the admission-budget calculation.
scope: 本課採用原創合成工作負載或事件資料，在紙面、試算表與離線模型中實作。來源用於查證具名案例；數值、擾動與驗收門檻是教學假設，不是實機效能或正式環境變更規格。實驗限自己的或明確授權的隔離環境，交付可重算的證據紀錄。
scopeEn: Use original synthetic workloads or event data in paper, spreadsheet, and offline-model investigations. References establish named case context; numerical inputs, perturbations, and limits are teaching assumptions, not measured machine performance or production change specifications. Use owned or explicitly authorized isolated environments and deliver reproducible evidence records.

optionsEn: Using observed CPU two plus 2.5 to grant admission mixes unrelated quantities. If quota passes but a Pod remains Pending, inspect node capacity, dependent resources and scheduling constraints next.

Draw a one-page evidence map from those inputs to outputs, identify the responsible roles, and locate the corresponding semantic contract in the cited project documentation. Represent requests as integer millicores, using 600m and 2500m to avoid floating-point rejection at exactly 8000m. Include a missing request resolved through a default, producing effective_request before summation. Add another-resource quota failure to demonstrate that passing CPU quota does not satisfy every admission condition.

stages.title: 拆開三種CPU量
stages.description: 多租戶演練的命名空間仍有低CPU使用率，卻被拒絕建立Pod；本課拆開requests配額、實際用量與節點可排程容量。 從合成Pod清單累計CPU requests，計算新Pod是否超額；另記limits及觀測用量，禁止以低使用率繞過額度判斷。 將上述邊界、欄位與負責角色畫成一頁輸入到輸出的證據圖，對照來源文件定位需要保留的語意。 以毫核心整數表示600m及2500m，避免浮點誤差把剛好8000m判超額。加入request缺失但有預設的案例，先產生effective_request；另加入其他resource quota失敗，說明CPU通過並非所有准入條件通過。
stages.descriptionEn: A namespace in a multitenant exercise shows low CPU utilization yet cannot admit another Pod. The case separates requested-resource quota, actual usage and node-level scheduling capacity. Sum CPU requests from a synthetic Pod inventory and decide whether a new Pod exceeds quota. Record limits and observed utilization separately; low current usage must not bypass the admission-budget calculation. Draw a one-page evidence map from those inputs to outputs, identify the responsible roles, and locate the corresponding semantic contract in the cited project documentation. Represent requests as integer millicores, using 600m and 2500m to avoid floating-point rejection at exactly 8000m. Include a missing request resolved through a default, producing effective_request before summation. Add another-resource quota failure to demonstrate that passing CPU quota does not satisfy every admission condition.
